title: ReadableStream + Opus encoder pipeline
blurb: Wraps an indefinite-length OfflineAudioContext in a ReadableStream (pull = startRendering, cancel = close) and pipes it into a WebCodecs Opus AudioEncoder.
question: Does a ReadableStream's backpressure stop the audio graph rendering ahead of a slow consumer, and does cancelling the stream stop the context?
result: Yes. Rendered-ahead never exceeded highWaterMark (1 at highWaterMark 1, 16 at 16, 1 at 0); cancel() closed the context and a pending render rejected with AbortError. Opus output was about 12 KB per audio second.
testedIn: Chrome for Testing 158.0.8127.36 (Linux, headless, no flags) on 2026-11-27
